description: 9 grahas (Navagraha) with karaka significations, friendships, natural benefic/malefic, and traditional remedies.
commercial_flags: Gemstone prescriptions require a credentialed Jyotishi; never auto-prescribe blue sapphire or similar without chart review.
Medical/psychological claims from graha significations are symbolic only — not diagnosis.
Mantra/fasting remedies are traditional cultural practices; present as educational/entertainment.

grahas.charity: Wheat, copper, red cloth; help father-figures or government workers

grahas.karaka: Mind (Manas), mother, emotions, public, fluids, fertility, memory, breasts, lungs
grahas.nature: Benefic when waxing; malefic when strongly waning
grahas.charity: Rice, milk, white cloth; support mothers or care workers

grahas.karaka: Intellect, speech, commerce, writing, mathematics, skin, nervous system, maternal uncle, friends

grahas.karaka: Wisdom, dharma, children, teacher, husband (female chart), wealth, higher learning, liver, fat
